agyos_skill.intent: Local and headless web scraping playbook for Google Maps, directories, and business leads. Covers query generation, rate limiting, proxy handling, data normalization, and CSV/JSON export.
agyos_skill.instructions: Autonomous operational playbook for extracting verified business leads, local service listings, and directory data using containerized scrapers and headless browser automation. To scrape local business directories or Google Maps without truncation: 1. Query Structuring: - Combine target industry keyword with granular geographic tokens: - `"<niche> in <suburb>, <city>"` - Example: `"pediatric dentists in North Denver, CO"` 2. Bounding Box & Grid Traversal: - High-density metros return capped result counts (typically 120-200 listings max per viewport). - Divide metropolitan areas into a 3x3 or 4x4 coordinate grid using latitude/longitude bounding steps. - Run localized queries per cell to extract full directory depth. Normalize all extracted lead records to this typed schema: ```json { "business_name": "string (required)", "phone": "string (E.164 formatted)", "website": "string (URL with https:// prefix)", "category": "string (primary business category)", "address": "string (street, city, state, postal code)", "latitude": "number (float)", "longitude": "number (float)", "rating": "number (float, 1.0 - 5.0)", "review_count": "integer", "verified": "boolean", "opening_hours": "object", "scraped_at": "string (ISO 8601 timestamp)"
